_note: Unique pose per card — avoid default two-hand lean. Same bulk tank + fat greatsword identity.

full.strike: Mid horizontal greatsword SLASH — torso twisted, blade horizontal across frame with ember arc, one foot forward lunge, teeth gritted effort face. Not a static guard pose.
full.defend: Planted defensive WALL: greatsword driven tip-down into ground like a stake, body square, both hands on crossguard, shoulder lowered into impact, yellow sparks. Static but different from lean-forward attack.
full.feed: Reckless over-the-shoulder CHARGE from behind-ish angle, greatsword trailing behind him like a banner of bad decisions, wild grin looking back over shoulder.
full.gank: CROUCHING ambush from brush, body low, greatsword held low beside hip one-handed with free hand gesturing silence, only eyes and pauldrons above fog line.
full.flash: Fragmented BLINK: half-transparent afterimages stacked mid-step, sword mid-draw not fully up, white flash blooming from feet, body mid-twist.
full.firstblood: Victory pose: greatsword pointed skyward one-handed, other hand raised with gold coin pinched between fingers, head tilted cocky.
full.maincharacter: Spotlight strut: walking toward camera three-quarter, sword resting casually on ONE shoulder like a celebrity, free hand gesturing 'me'.
full.pentakill: Kneeling finisher over defeated silhouettes, both hands on pommel of vertical planted greatsword, exhausted proud smile, five tally marks on blade.
full.afk: Sitting on ground against a rock, helmet/pauldrons half off vibe, greatsword propped beside him untouched, head down asleep Zzz, totally slack.
full.inting: Arms wide open taunt walk INTO danger, greatsword dragging tip on ground behind him one-handed, manic laugh face.
full.peel: Sideways BODYCHECK — shoulder-first tackle into an incoming projectile, greatsword held horizontal as barrier across chest, ally silhouette behind him.
full.catch: Greatsword HOOKED under an enemy silhouette's arm/leg, Brennen leaning back hauling them in, strained face, two-handed pull.
full.emote: Ridiculous dance: greatsword spinning overhead like a baton (or resting on head), goofy open-mouth smile, one knee up mid-step.
full.inter: Chaotic windmill: greatsword whirling in a wild overhead circle, body off-balance, panic/manic eyes, dirt flying.
full.flashengage: Airborne LEAP mid-flash, greatsword raised high overhead for a downward crash, both hands on hilt above head, feet off ground.
full.outplay: Lean-back dodge: body arched backward under a skillshot, greatsword sweeping low counter, smug wink-ish expression.
full.shutdown: Overhead CHOP landing on a gold-bounty silhouette, three-quarter from above, impact shockwave, fierce concentration.
full.invade: Sprinting profile facing right, greatsword held back for a running cut, motion lines, jungle vines.
full.allin: Both feet planted, greatsword fully extended in a full-extension THRUST toward right edge, body stretched almost horizontal with the lunge.
full.disrespect: Sitting on a defeated foe silhouette like a chair, greatsword across his lap, examining nails / smug chin-up, totally relaxed.
full.peelbot: Standing shield-wall in front of small ally, greatsword planted, free hand outstretched blocking, looking left at threat while body faces right.
full.ace: Arms raised victory V with greatsword in one hand high, other fist pump, five enemy silhouettes fallen, looking up.
full.pentasecure: Sliding on knees under camera, greatsword stabbing forward into ground to stop, gold rain, focused grit.
full.onevnine: Surrounded circle, back partly to camera, greatsword spinning defensive arc, many enemy silhouettes around, desperate yell.
full.clutch: On one knee wounded but still up, greatsword braced as crutch/guard, blood/sparks, gritted teeth determined.
full.intingsion: Unkillable zombie walk facing camera, greatsword over shoulder, glowing eyes, shambling bulk.
full.fountaindive: Diving DOWNWARD into blue fountain beams, greatsword leading the dive headfirst-ish, dynamic diagonal composition.
full.bait: Staggering low HP pose, one knee, free hand beckoning 'come on', greatsword limp in other hand, glowing bait aura.
full.topdiff: Towering high-angle looking DOWN on tiny foe silhouette, greatsword resting tip-down, arms crossed over hilt, arrogant.
full.jgdiff: Standing atop a camp carcass, greatsword planted, smite lightning in free raised hand, jungle king pose.
full.supdiff: Kneeling to boost/pull ally up with free hand, greatsword planted behind, caring protector face (different soft expression).
full.middiff: Mirror duel pose: greatsword point-to-point with enemy silhouette, profile side-view facing right, elegant stance.
full.dodgethedodge: Frozen mid-sidestep, body horizontal-ish lean, greatsword trailing, timing lines, focused eyes tracking projectile.
full.maincharactersyndrome: Camera-hog pose: leaning into frame close-up bust+sword, blocking ally silhouettes behind, exaggerated selfie energy.
full.peelforadc: Backhand SWAT with flat of greatsword shoving a diver away from ADC silhouette, athletic twist, protective snarl.
full.bodyblock: Arms crossed over chest tanking a red beam on his BACK (facing away from camera mostly), greatsword hanging loose, ally safe in front of him.
full.teamfight: Wide shot: Brennen small-left frontlining, many silhouettes, greatsword horizontal block, dynamic multi-figure composition not centered portrait.
full.frontline: Absolute wall: feet wide, greatsword held horizontal with both hands at chest height like a bar, taunt rings, facing right, immovable.
full.ult: Greatsword SLAM into ground creating radial shockwave, body crouched after impact, dust and ember, power pose.
full.diff: Casual walk-by, greatsword on shoulder one-handed, not even looking at crushed foe silhouette, bored superiority.
full.challengerdiff: Ascending pose: climbing/standing on rank podium glow, greatsword raised high one-handed, free hand open, triumphant.
